name: Hildegard of Bingen
shortBio: German Benedictine abbess, natural philosopher, and visionary polymath who articulated 'viriditas'—the greening, life-giving cosmic vitality uniting ecological nature, human embodiment, and divine wisdom.
centralQuestion: How does cosmic vitality (viriditas) weave together human embodiment, natural healing, and rational participation in the order of creation?

keyWorks.title: Scivias (Know the Ways)
keyWorks.description: Systematic theological and cosmological work uniting visionary metaphysics with moral anthropology.

keyWorks.title: Liber Divinorum Operum (Book of Divine Works)
keyWorks.description: Articulates microcosm-macrocosm cosmology and the generative vitality of viriditas across nature and soul.
